title: Community-validated platform entry
description: One entry of configs/community/platforms.json — a third-party hardware-validation submission for Qwen3.8-27B on a non-gfx1151 AMD GPU. Community entries carry the submitter's own receipts; they never change project verdicts or quickstart defaults (docs/hardware-validation.md).

id.description: Stable platform id, e.g. w7900-gfx1100-rocm714. Must match the receipts directory name under docs/results/matrix-714/community/.

submitter.description: GitHub handle or name of the submitter (the person who ran the cells).

arch.description: GCN/RDNA arch as reported by rocminfo, e.g. gfx1100. gfx1151 is the project-validated host and does not belong in the community index.

marketing_name.description: Marketing name from rocminfo, e.g. Radeon PRO W7900.

vram_gib.description: Discrete VRAM (GiB) from the submitter's rocm-smi receipt. Discrete boards have no UMA/GTT pool — do not report system RAM here.

kernel.description: Linux kernel release of the submitter's host, e.g. 6.17.0.

pytorch_source.description: Where the submitter's PyTorch came from, e.g. 'official rocm wheel 2.9' — the project's TheRock index has no gfx1100 builds, so submitters bring their own and must say so.

vllm_source.description: vLLM source pin, e.g. 'upstream main @<full sha>' plus any local patches.

llama_cpp_commit.description: llama.cpp commit used for the GGUF-path cells.

gguf.description: True when GGUF-path cells from this platform's receipts are healthy (boots + anchors clean).

vllm.description: True when vLLM-path cells from this platform's receipts are healthy.

env_check.description: Saved output of 'bash scripts/00-check-env.sh --profile community', committed under the platform's community receipts tree.

items.description: Raw cell JSONs / cell directory produced by the project's own run-cell-*.sh runners, under the platform's community receipts tree.
